request.questionText: Which of the following is true of the normal distribution model? Select all correct answers.

choices.label: A
choices.text: A normal random variable is a discrete random variable.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Phenomena that don’t look obviously normal can be sometimes described using the normal distribution as a building block.

choices.label: C
choices.text: The parameters of the normal distribution are the median and the rate.

choices.label: D
choices.text: It is a family of bell-shaped density curves, each with a different mean and standard deviation.

choices.label: E
choices.text: The area under a normal density curve represents probability.
